visual_checks.name: tile_grid_seams
visual_checks.evidence: No horizontal or vertical lines at 32px or 16px spacing visible in any diff10 image. All three diff10 images lack grid-pattern artifacts.

visual_checks.name: tile_uniform_fill
visual_checks.evidence: No square constant-color blocks in rendered images. All rendered images show continuous smooth shading matching reference character geometry.

visual_checks.name: missing_splat_holes
visual_checks.evidence: No local dark regions larger than ~16px where reference has coverage. Brightness and coverage match reference across all three views. Some fine speckle at surface edges is below the threshold.

visual_checks.name: color_clipping_bands
visual_checks.evidence: No saturated flat-colored stripes in any rendered image. Color distribution matches reference in hero (orange ear, pink tongue, blue body), side (dark navy), and top (blue/pink ear) views.

visual_checks.name: ringing_halos
visual_checks.evidence: No structured ringing or halos at object silhouettes visible in any view. Edges appear natural in both rendered and diff10 images.

visual_checks.name: nan_inf_signatures
visual_checks.evidence: No pure black/white/magenta patches in spatially-correlated patterns. All pixel values appear within normal color range across all three renders.

visual_checks.name: geometry_shift
visual_checks.evidence: Diff10 shows distributed surface speckle on the object body — a characteristic of binning/culling changes reducing low-contribution splats — not a hard silhouette shift indicating wrong coordinates. Object shape, ears, and facial features are in correct positions matching reference.

visual_checks.name: diff10_structure
visual_checks.evidence: Hero diff10 shows uniform fine speckle across the object surface with no grid lines or banding. Side diff10 is very dark with minimal uniform noise. Top diff10 shows distributed speckle concentrated on object surface. No structured grid, band, or edge patterns that would indicate tile-level artifacts.

reasoning: All visual checks pass. No tile grid seams, uniform fill blocks, color clipping, ringing, NaN/Inf signatures, or geometry shift detected in any of the three views. The diff10 images show fine-grained speckle distributed across the object surface, consistent with a binning/contribution-floor change that culls low-opacity splats — not structured artifacts. PSNR for all three views (hero 39.92 dB, side 43.86 dB, top 39.15 dB) exceeds the binning-class floor of 35 dB. Max per-view PSNR delta is 4.72 dB (well within 20 dB limit). Max per-view kernel-ms ratio is 1.29x (well within 2x limit). kernel_ms_median of 46.961 ms represents a 4.83% improvement over prev_best of 49.447 ms, comfortably within the 1.02x break-even threshold. p99/median ratio of 1.241x is well within the 3x suspicious-tail threshold. This iteration is a clear KEEP.
